function.name: emit_sidecar_verdict
function.arguments: {"verdict": "accept", "reason": "The diff and final answer satisfy the retained REQUIREMENTS.md spec: billing/quote.py adds a frozen Quote(currency, subtotal_minor, discount_minor, total_minor) and quote_order(lines, *, currency=\"USD\", discount_bps=0) with exact Decimal math, per-line HALF_UP rounding after multiplication, rounded-line summation, HALF_UP order-level discount, total = subtotal - discount, currency/discount validation even for empty orders, no input mutation, unrelated keys ignored, and ValueError for all required invalid inputs. All five consumers (web.checkout, cli.receipt, jobs.export, mobile.summary, reporting.monthly) were migrated to the central Quote with the exact documented output formats ({\"currency\",\"total_minor\"}, \"USD 12.30\"/\"JPY 1230\", \"currency,total_minor\\nUSD,1230\\n\", \"12.30\", integer) and keyword-only currency/discount_bps defaults. billing.legacy.total_amount is preserved, and the consumers no longer reference it. README documents usage, currencies, rounding, validation, and the legacy boundary. Tests were updated plus new contract coverage, and the exact acceptance command passed (18 passed). Remaining limitations are disclosed. No blocking counterexample found in the audited diff."}
